body:
Implements the CONTENT half of tutorial v3: the fifteen lessons of
.adlc/specs/48-arc-script.md (Myk-approved draft 2 — it is the script, follow it beat for
beat; deviations that improve teaching are welcome ONLY where they keep every settled decision:
the viewings spine, the evolution lesson's both-directions proof, the reveal at 11, the key
download closing lesson 1, Rae re-keyed in 13, the sweep as the finale's loss, the homecoming
carrying the erasure). Depends on T226's player (edge enforced) — read its landed code first.

Build:
1. THE LESSONS. lessons.mjs replaces the stub with the fifteen: every step carrying
   have/want/how in the arc's plain-language register (write for a person who has never met a
   database — the script's beats are the register), run, and BOTH observe predicates. Lesson
   ROLE markers where T226's suite targets mechanics (reveal, erasure-finale, evolution,
   homecoming). The prose is first-class craft — the poetry rule is load-bearing here; June
   cried at the recipe scene, and this arc's rewatch/movie-night/homecoming beats deserve the
   same care.
2. THE TERMS MANIFEST. The arc exports its glossary terms (21 — the script's ordered list is authoritative; its header said 20, a recorded miscount) in introduction order (the
   script's settled list); every introduction plants its glossary delta with the plain-words
   definition; the vocabulary scan asserts intro-before-first-bare-use for every term over all
   lesson copy (spec criterion 10) — a lesson that slips a term early goes red in CI naming
   the term and the lesson.
3. THE QUIZ BANKS. Five act-closing quizzes from the script, three questions each, teaches
   pointers to the exact step.
4. THE FINALE WIRING. Lesson 14 triggers T226's sweep machinery against real checkpoints;
   lesson 15's homecoming drives the real export/compare and queries the erased note's absence
   (the erasure-travels observable). The §26 as-of lesson (06) and the finale's as-of footnote
   use the annotation the doors already serve.
5. THE DATA RAIL. test/site/arc.test.ts (editable — T226 left it undeclared) grows to walk all
   fifteen lessons headlessly: every step's store predicate, the glossary trail, the vocabulary
   scan, the progress-claims floor per event kind. Declare it in THIS ticket's rails at P3,
   together with any new lesson-content browser cases that fit the role-driven suite WITHOUT
   editing T226's frozen files (new cases go in a new file if needed — the frozen-rail
   discipline).

Acceptance criteria: spec 48's criteria 1 (full-arc coverage), 8 (the finale sweep against the
real arc), and 10 (vocabulary discipline), plus: (a) all fifteen lessons pass the generic
browser walk and the headless walk, red-proven by the T226 red-probe mechanism against one
lesson; (b) the terms manifest matches the script's ordered list exactly (21 terms), scan green, and a deliberately
early term insertion goes red naming it (two-sided); (c) the homecoming's erasure-travels
observable holds at the bytes of the exported store. Merge tier: build of an approved design —
self-merge on the ordinary bar. The LANDING (spec/48 prose, capabilities chapter, archiving
T211+T106) follows as its own P6 PR for Myk after both tickets land.
title: Tutorial v3, the arc — fifteen lessons of A Store of Your Own
